chunks: Al-Tawhid: Al-Hamdani, from Ali, from his father, from al-Harawi, from Ali ibn Musa al-Rida, from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has ninety-nine names. Whoever calls upon Allah by them is answered, and whoever enumerates them enters Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Allah's ninety-nine names in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This foundational hadith, transmitted through the Ahl al-Bayt chain, establishes the concept of Asma al-Husna (the Beautiful Names) as a means of divine connection and salvation. While the number ninety-nine is widely accepted in Shia tradition as a symbolic representation of completeness rather than a strict limit, the emphasis lies on the spiritual practice of memorization (ihṣāʾ) and invocation (duʿāʾ) to attain Paradise. It underscores the Shia belief in the intercessory and mediating role of the Prophet's household in preserving and interpreting divine attributes.
